claims.statement: Pictelio is a Lynx single-engine client: the WebView client source, its Capacitor plugins, and the `packages/app` tree were removed (ADR-0203), so the image pipeline now spans `packages/android-host` (Android Gradle host + shared Java image core and Lynx native modules), `packages/app-lynx` (vue-lynx client), and `packages/ugoira` (shared pure-TS ugoira library).

`PixivImageLoader` (ADR-0054) is the single source of truth for image bytes: it rewrites `/pixiv-img/{path}` to `OAuthConfig.IMAGE_CDN_URL + "/" + path` with URI normalization, keys a disk cache under `pictelio-images/` with Base64 URL-safe names and oldest-first byte-budget eviction, downloads via the shared OkHttp pool with `Referer`/`User-Agent`, throws on non-2xx or empty bodies without caching, and serializes concurrent same-URL loads with a per-URL lock plus double-check.

`PictelioImageService` is the sole image backend for the Lynx client: it implements `ILynxImageService`, registers `<image>`/`<inline-image>` behaviors at construction, and `fetchImage` checks the bitmap memory cache then delegates to `PixivImageLoader`, samples-decodes with a 2048 px cap, and delivers `ImageContent`; animation hooks are static-only and a canonical-path-whitelisted `file://` branch serves ugoira frames from `cache/ugoira/`.

A 64 MB native `ImageMemoryCache` (built on the generic pure-JVM `LruCache`) caches decoded bitmaps keyed by URL with byte size `width × height × 4` and LRU eviction, so a revisit skips disk read plus decode; delivery uses the cached instance directly with an `isRecycled()` guard instead of a per-delivery `ARGB_8888` copy.

`ImageHostConfig.resolve(officialUrl)` (ADR-0143) decides the download source in Java: `single` uses the selected host, `weighted` samples enabled weight>0 hosts, `fastest-ip` uses a 30 s-TTL probe with immediate weighted fallback, and `race` degrades to `weighted`; the cache key is always the official URL; mirror failure retries the official URL once under a smaller mirror budget; and `pximg.net`/`pixiv.net` mirror hosts are skipped to prevent self-looping.

`ImageHostConfig` reads `image_host_settings` from `SharedPreferences("CapacitorStorage")`, parses lazily with corrupt config treated as host-off, and triggers a single-flight `fastest-ip` probe on a dedicated executor with a 5 s timeout whose result is cached for 30 s; its write-side settings UI was removed with the WebView client.

Native ugoira playback extracts frames in Java via `PictelioApi.ugoiraExtract`: it downloads the zip (https-only with `Referer`/UA), decompresses with `ZipInputStream`, writes `cache/ugoira/<illustId>/frame_N.{png|jpg}`, returns `file://` URLs, skips the download when a per-illust integrity check hits, and LRU-cleans the directory at 300 files / 50 MB.

`UgoiraStreamEngine` + `ugoiraExtractStream`/`ugoiraExtractStreamPoll`/`ugoiraExtractStreamCancel` (ADR-0128) stream the zip with a local-header-driven `ZipInputStream`, write frames to disk in batches and deliver `file://` URL batches through a pull-mode state machine; cache hits deliver all frames in one poll, cancel preserves written frames, and the first batch arrives at roughly 4.5–8.6% of the download.

`@pictelio/ugoira` is the shared pure-TS ugoira library: `index.ts` parses EOCD/central-directory and slices or unzips frames for store and deflate entries, while `createStreamFrameSource` (ADR-0127) emits frames in `fileOrder` as each entry completes, buffers out-of-order entries, and throws a `ugoira:`-prefixed error on corruption or missing frames.

In `packages/app-lynx`, static images pass through `proxyImageUrl` (i.pximg.net → `/pixiv-img/`, with a `pximg.net`/`pixiv.net` host whitelist), and `UgoiraViewer.vue` uses `downloadUgoiraFrames` (fflate/range → base64 `data:` URLs, with range degrading to fflate) in web mode versus `ugoiraExtractStreamFrames` (with full `ugoiraExtractFrames` fallback) in native mode, scheduling frames by `delay` with `defer-src-invalidation` and tail-waiting while streaming.
